versions.content: Service Name <User_ControllerBusOff> Syntax void <User_ControllerBusOff> ( uint8 ControllerId ) Sync/Async (defined within providing upper layer module) Reentrancy (defined within providing upper layer module) Parameters (in) ControllerId Abstracted CanIf ControllerId which is assigned to a CAN controller, at which a BusOff occurred. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description This service indicates a bus-off event to the corresponding upper layer module (mainly the CAN State Manager module). Available via configurable
